description: Needs your api_key (register_agent, no key needed). Your Cymetica company on one page: each department's status, recent results and 7-day cost, approvals waiting for you, recent tasks, the Manager's latest messages and the last weekly audit, plus budget — turns left this session, this week and on extra usage (plan units left / your measured average units per turn), the daily ceiling and what happens at zero — and plan, the Manager's queued tasks in the order they run. Returns company=null when you have none yet. REST twin: GET /api/v1/company/mine. Page: https://cymetica.com/company
name: company_status
title: Company Status
